items.title: Willie J. Humphrey and Willie E. Humphrey Interview, 1959-03-15
items.q: Heisenbaum. Heisenbaum. Oh, we had a whole lot of musicians around there.

ctx.x: Heisenbaum. Heisenbaum. Oh, we had a whole lot of musicians around there. Oh, yeah. There were so many. Yeah, you'd remember. You'd be writing a long time. Every once in a while, I'd think about some new ones.
Yeah, yeah, yeah. Anybody know what time it is? Steve. Steve Lewis. You know if you heard about Steve? The piano player, yeah. Yeah. Huh? Ten after four.
